name: Filled Blue Waterskin
label: Item
description: Shamans gather water for their trials at the Ruins of Stardust in Ashenvale. The Filled Blue Waterskin carries a pristine sample from the ancient fountain.
intro: Shamans gather water for their trials at the Ruins of Stardust in Ashenvale. The Filled Blue Waterskin carries a pristine sample from the ancient fountain.

p: Call of Water initiates cross north from the Barrens into Ashenvale's dense forests. Beyond Lake Mystral, the Ruins of Stardust lie against the mountains dividing Ashenvale from Stonetalon. Fierce forest beasts guard the secluded elven sanctuary. At the center of its lake, an untouched fountain holds water untainted by corruption or drought. A blue waterskin filled from its basin carries the sample sought by shaman masters for ritual attunement.

Brine, a hermit and water expert, lives on a hill in the southern Barrens and needs this final sample. She combines it with water from contrasting wells and springs, then distills the pure essence into an offering. The offering can manifest and soothe the elemental spirits of water, completing an initiate's trial.
